messages:
Maya (AE): Heads-up — Auriga legal wants completed SIG v3 + CAIQ crosswalk by EOD Monday. They called out encryption, KMS ownership, and tenant isolation as non-negotiable.
Owen (Security): Understood. Do they want granular Q-by-Q evidence or a high-level controls pack?
Maya (AE): Q-by-Q with attachments per question. They specifically want evidence linked for questions in ENCR/KEY/ACCESS sections.
Ritika (Solutions): I'll start mapping SIG IDs -> artifacts. ETA tomorrow morning. Which artifacts are mandatory from Security's POV?
Owen (Security): Minimal set: redacted SOC2 (covering CC6), KMS key policy + rotation logs, DB/storage encryption config, SCIM/SSO setup sample, network layout for private deployments, and latest vuln scan summary.
Nia (Legal): Reminder: anything with customer tenant IDs or internal hostnames must be redacted. Use the secure-share process we documented last quarter. I'll prep a DPA template if they need it signed before SOC2.
evidence-bot: Uploaded items: SOC2_redacted_2024.pdf, kms_rotation_logs_2025.csv, scim_config_snip.txt, private_vpc_network_layout.png
Ritika (Solutions): Quick question on SIG 2.1.4 (key rotation): recommended answer draft — "We support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM). Our rotation process is documented and can be executed without service downtime; contact SRE for onboarding." OK to use?
Owen (Security): Fine, but add an ops snippet and link to runbook. Keep it operational (no roadmap).
Ritika (Solutions): Adding runbook excerpt. Will include this example CLI for the rotation steps:
```
# example: schedule rotation + update deployment config
aws kms schedule-key-rotation --key-id arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abcd1234
kubectl set env deployment/ri-backend REDWOOD_KMS_KEY=new-key-id --record
```
Maya (AE): Auriga also asked whether we offer HSM-backed keys and whether rotation can be customer-driven.
Owen (Security): We support HSM integrations for Private or Dedicated. Customer-driven rotation is supported with onboarding - ops needs to swap the key ARN and trigger a config rollout. I'll note that precisely.
Nia (Legal): If they request customer-managed HSM, we'll need a clause in the DPA and possibly an addendum around key custody. I'll draft language.
Ritika (Solutions): I've created auriga_sig_mapping_v1.xlsx (question -> suggested answer -> artifact filename). I flagged ~8 questions for Legal wording.
Maya (AE): Great. Plan: Ritika/Owen finalize mapping + artifacts by Mon 11:30am, Nia to send DPA draft by then if needed, I'll consolidate and upload a single encrypted zip via secure-share.
Ritika (Solutions): Will also prepare a short readme that lists which files are redacted and what was removed (tenant IDs, hostnames).
Owen (Security): Adding a line for data residency: "EU-only residency supported via Private deployment or region-pinned Dedicated; contractual controls available." I'll attach a screenshot of the region selector.
Maya (AE): Perfect. After we get Legal sign-off, I'll push the bundle to Auriga procurement. Thanks all. :pray: 
Nia (Legal): One more: we should avoid saying "no downtime" as absolute. Use "no expected service disruption when following documented rotation steps." I'll update the phrasing.
Ritika (Solutions): Noted. I'll edit the answers accordingly and upload final_auriga_sig_bundle.zip to secure-share once Legal gives the OK. :white_check_mark:
